title: Activation-aware INT8 (SmoothQuant) pipeline and runtime kernel integration
creator: Maya Patel
description: Implement an activation-aware post-training INT8 quantization pipeline (SmoothQuant-style) plus the necessary runtime kernel primitives and rollout plan. Deliverables: (1) offline calibration/quant-profile generator that takes a model artifact and representative dataset and emits per-tensor/per-channel scale metadata; (2) weight transformation and folding tooling to apply activation scaling to weights (SmoothQuant transform) and produce quantized model blobs; (3) runtime kernel support for scaled-matmul and fused scale + GEMM paths (per-tensor and per-channel INT8); (4) integration with serving pipeline to select quantized variants and runtime fallbacks; (5) accuracy validation harness and automated regression checks integrated into the CI/CD eval pipeline.
decision_log: 2025-02-26: Decided to prioritize post-training SmoothQuant-style transforms over mixed-precision retraining due to customer demand for fast turnarounds.
2025-02-27: Use per-channel symmetric INT8 for weights and per-tensor asymmetric INT8 for activations to balance accuracy and kernel complexity.
2025-03-01: Runtime will implement a fused scaled-GEMM kernel that accepts precomputed activation scaling factors to avoid extra elementwise ops at inference hotpath.
2025-03-02: Calibration dataset must include long-tail prompts and edge-case token sequences; will be configurable by customers for private deployments.
comments: 2025-02-25 Maya Patel: Initial ticket created after spike showing ~2.4x memory reduction and 10-15% token throughput improvement on sample Llama-2-13B with SmoothQuant transform + INT8 weights.
2025-02-26 Diego Ramirez: Spike validated feasibility; next step is a robust calibration pipeline and a proto fused-kernel in runtime-branch 'sq/int8-kernel'.
2025-02-28 Priya Shah (QA): Added acceptance tests for PPL and QA metrics; we need guardrails to auto-reject profiles that increase PPL by >1.5%.
2025-03-01 Jordan Lee (Performance): Microbenchmarks show fused scaled-GEMM reduces extra memory traffic; need to audit NVTX traces for KV cache changes.
2025-03-03 Diego Ramirez: Implemented prototype calibration CLI; pushing PR for review. TODO: add per-channel clipping heuristics and percentile-based outlier handling.
tests: e2e_calibration_flow: generate profile -> apply transform -> quantize -> serve -> compare outputs vs FP16 baseline
accuracy_regression_suite: perplexity (WikiText-103), exact-match (SQuAD-like prompts), and a set of hallucination prompts
perf_benchmark: throughput (tokens/sec) and p50/p95 token latency across model sizes (7B, 13B, 70B) on target GPUs
robustness: evaluate on long-context prompts and adversarial token sequences
integration: CI job that runs quantized-model inference on a small cluster and validates model checksum and perf thresholds
acceptance_criteria: Quantization tool can produce an INT8 artifact and a JSON profile file from a standard model archive without manual graph edits.
Runtime exposes fused scaled-GEMM kernel; serving can use quantized model and meet latency SLO within 5% of FP16 for common batch sizes.
Accuracy regression: average perplexity increase <= 1.0% on validation set, and no pipeline increases PPL by >1.5% on any model tested.
Automated calibration workflow integrated into CI: profiles are generated and validated automatically for every quantization PR.
Customer-facing docs and console flags for toggling quantized variants and viewing quant-profile metadata are published.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): internal-only evaluation on dedicated cluster with canary traffic (2 weeks). Phase 2 (beta): expose quantized variants to selected customers on Dedicated with opt-in. Phase 3 (GA): enable in hosted as opt-in and add automatic profiling suggestions in Optimize UI. Provide emergency rollback (FP16 fallback) and a quality circuit-breaker that prevents serving a profile if regression thresholds are exceeded.
risks_and_mitigations: Calibration dataset bias: mitigation -> provide standard 'redwood-calib-1' dataset and allow customer-supplied datasets; use percentile clipping to limit outlier influence.
Kernel complexity and maintenance burden: mitigation -> implement fused kernel as a configurable codepath with clear abstraction layer; add thorough performance unit tests and GPU regression alerts.
Accuracy regressions in corner cases: mitigation -> conservative defaults, 'safe' profile that keeps activations in FP16 when model-level regression detected, and automatic rollback in serving plane.
KV cache compatibility: mitigation -> extend KV cache encode/decode to support quantized activations or store cached keys in FP16 and recompute scaled-values on the fly.
